001: Ivan, have you already chosen what you'll give Mom for her birthday?
Almost. I was looking at a food processor, but I'm not sure about the model yet.
And what does she have now? Maybe it's better to get something different?
She has an old one, still from grandma. I want to find something modern and reliable.
Then pay attention to the reviews. I recently bought electronics online and I'm very satisfied.
Thanks for the advice! I'll look tonight at what they write about different models.
002: Dmitry, do you know where they accept returns here without a receipt?
Usually in this store, returns are processed with a passport if you have a warranty card.
Great. And what if the item just doesn't fit in size?
Then the packaging needs to be intact, and it's better to make it within fourteen days.
I see. And will the money be returned to the card right away?
Yes, if you paid by card. With cash, unfortunately, it won't be possible anymore.
003: Look, I found that dress online, but the price is suspiciously low.
Hmm, that's usually a sign of a fake. Check the seller and read the store reviews.
You're right. The site doesn't have a contact phone number, only an order form.
I wouldn't risk it. Better to pay more but buy from a trusted place.
Yeah, I guess so. Besides, shipping from abroad would take way too long.
Exactly. And at the mall, you could at least try it on.
004: I need to buy a new suitcase, but I don't know what size to choose.
It depends on where you're going. For a short trip, a small one is enough.
I'm planning to go for two weeks, and I want to take a lot of things.
Then get a medium one, around forty to fifty liters. It's more convenient on transport.
And is there a difference between a hard and a soft shell?
A hard one protects your things better, but a soft one is lighter and fits more inside.
005: Sergey, can you tell me where I can buy good coffee beans?
There's a great coffee shop on the next street; they sell fresh roasts.
And what's the price? I'm willing to pay for quality, but I don't want to overpay.
It's quite reasonable there. They ask about eight hundred rubles for half a kilo.
That's fine. And can they grind it right at the purchase?
Of course, you just tell them what brewing method it's for, and they'll take care of it.
006: I ordered sneakers online, but they turned out to be a size too big.
That's annoying. Have you tried to arrange an exchange yet?
Yes, I wrote to support. They said the exchange is possible within a month.
Great. The main thing is that you don't have to pay for the return shipping.
Luckily, the shipping is on them. But I'll have to wait a few more days.
No big deal. At least you'll get exactly what you need.
007: Look at these beautiful cups! Maybe we should buy a set as a gift for the colleagues?
Good idea. But let's check if they're available in another color.
There are only blue ones in the display case. I'll ask the salesperson what's in the warehouse.
Yes, ask. And find out if they can arrange delivery to the office.
I'll find out now. If they don't have the right color, we'll take the white ones.
Deal. The main thing is that they're made of quality porcelain.
008: Do you know if they sell gift certificates in this department?
Yes, they're at the checkout. You can choose any amount.
Great, that solves my problem with a gift for my dad.
What, you don't know what to get him?
Exactly. He says he already has everything. And he'll spend the certificate on what he needs himself.
Smart move. That way you can't go wrong with the gift, and the person stays happy.
009: I saw a discount on home appliances in an ad. Do you happen to know if it's still active?
Yes, the promotion runs until the end of the week. But the discount doesn't apply to all models.
And to which ones exactly? I'm looking at a new vacuum cleaner.
Robot vacuums have a twenty percent discount, but regular ones only have ten.
Then maybe it's worth getting a robot? It's more convenient, even if it's pricier.
Agreed. You'll save time on cleaning, and that's worth it.
010: Dmitry, can you help me pick out headphones? I'm totally confused by all the models.
Sure. First, tell me what you're going to use them for.
Mostly for calls and music on my way to work.
Then get wireless ones with good noise cancellation. They're more convenient on the subway.
What else should I pay attention to? The battery life?
Definitely. Make sure the charge lasts at least the whole day.
